name: thinkcell-codex
description: Create and position native think-cell charts from donors and update their data with automatic naming and native verification.

interface.shortDescription: Create and update native think-cell charts
interface.longDescription: A Windows desktop toolkit for donor-based native chart creation, JSON data updates, optional native style defaults, experimental automatic naming, and scoped data and native-render verification.
